scope: Purchase overview above the existing own-inventory list, using the sales overview layout

data.ownerScope: Verified current owner's records, including completed sales; identical for dealer, admin and accountant
data.period: Current calendar month and the last six months, plus previous-month and prior-year comparisons
data.missingOrInvalidDates: Excluded from monthly counts and shown as a separate date-check count
data.zeroBaseline: No percentage is invented when the comparison count is zero

behavior.graph: Read-only six-month line with pointer and keyboard tooltips
behavior.previousCountsCleared: On route, account, company, role, verified-scope or loading changes

checks: Korean month boundary, real dates and immutable source records
Completed purchases retained after sale; foreign and shared incoming records excluded
Admin and accountant remain in the same own-only scope despite a stale dealer filter
Search, status and pagination do not change overview totals
Account invalidation and loading remove old counts
Existing sales month selection and overview behavior remain unchanged
Compact side-by-side metrics and graph without overflow or hovering point displacement
No external API requests, source storage writes or unexpected browser errors in synthetic fixtures
